This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user is building a Shopify app called "Zip Code Checker" and has made multiple sequential requests:
   - Initial: Full app audit for Shopify submission compliance (UI/UX, code structure, Polaris compliance)
   - Widget page: Make the live preview panel sticky while scrolling the left config panel
   - ZIP Codes page: Add sample CSV download in import modal, fix export duplicate download bug, test all functions
   - Competitive analysis: Research 9 competitor apps and build a feature roadmap
   - Feature implementation: ZIP range import, COD/return policy fields, waitlist email notifications, cutoff time display, ATC blocking, global ZIP format support, cart validator block, social proof on waitlist
   - Menu changes: Add "Help & Support" as its own menu item above Settings; rename "Widget" to "Widget Customization"
   - Menu order: Best UX/psychology order for sidebar navigation
   - Cart validator schema fix: Fix missing `{% schema %}` tag error in cart-validator.liquid
   - Widget Customization page: Fix the "Add widget to storefront" first card UX — make it show real status based on actual app embed state, integrate with Shopify App Embed extension, and make cart-validator/zip-code-checker blocks only visible when app embed is enabled (following Shopify branded app best practices)

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - React Router 7 (NOT Remix) via `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1
   - Shopify Polaris v13 — only Polaris components for admin UI
   - Shopify Theme App Extensions (TAE) — Liquid blocks for storefront
   - App Embed blocks (`app_embed` target in shopify.extension.toml) — controls whether the app is enabled in a theme
   - Prisma v6 + SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod)
   - TypeScript throughout — zero plain .js files
   - `authenticate.admin(request)` — required before every Shopify API call
   - Shopify GraphQL Admin API — for querying theme/app embed status
   - sessionStorage bridge between widget and cart-validator blocks
   - ZIP code normalization (US ZIP+4, UK postcodes, India pincodes, AU/CA codes)
   - DOM manipulation for Add to Cart / Buy Now button disabling
   - Custom Events (`zcc:validated`) for widget state broadcasting
   - Shopify App Embed extension — the on/off toggle for the entire app in a theme

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - `extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/cart-validator.liquid`
     - NEW file created as cart page validation block
     - Was missing required `{% schema %}` tag — caused `AppBlockMissingSchema` error on dev server
     - Fix: appended `{% schema %}{"name": "Cart Validator","target": "section","settings": []}{% endschema %}` at end of file
   - `extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`
     - Updated with sessionStorage bridge (`zcc:valid`, `zcc:zip`, `zcc:shop`)
     - Added DOM button disabling for ATC/Buy Now on invalid ZIP
     - Added ZIP format normalization (US ZIP+4, UK, India, AU, CA)
     - Added social proof count display on waitlist form
     - Schema tag at end: `{"name": "Zip Code Checker","target": "section","settings": []}`
   - `extensions/zip-code-widget/shopify.extension.toml`
     - Registered cart-validator block
   - `prisma/schema.prisma`
     - Added to `ZipCode`: `codAvailable Boolean?`, `returnPolicy String?`
     - Added to `WidgetConfig`: `blockCartOnInvalid Boolean @default(false)`, `blockCheckoutInCart Boolean @default(false)`, `showSocialProof Boolean @default(true)`, `showCod Boolean @default(true)`, `showReturnPolicy Boolean @default(true)`
   - `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`
     - Added `range-import` action intent (generates 1-500 numeric US ZIP codes from start/end range)
     - Added `rangeModalOpen`, `rangeStart`, `rangeEnd`, `rangeZone`, `rangeType`, `rangeMessage`, `rangeEta` state vars
     - Added "Import Range" button in toolbar
     - Added full Range Import Modal with InlineGrid (Start/End ZIP), Select (status), optional Zone/Message/ETA fields
   - `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx`
     - Added `normalizeZipCode()` utility function
     - Returns `cutoffTime`, `daysOfWeek` from matching DeliveryRule
     - Returns `codAvailable`, `returnPolicy` from ZipCode
     - Returns `waitlistCount` in blocked responses when `showWaitlistOnFailure` is true
   - `app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx`
     - Applied `normalizeZipCode()` to zip parameter
   - `app/routes/app.widget.tsx`
     - Added "Block Add to Cart on Invalid ZIP" toggle
     - Added "Block Checkout in Cart" toggle (Pro+ gated)
     - Added "Show social proof count on waitlist" toggle
     - Added `showCod`, `showReturnPolicy` toggles
     - First card ("Add widget to storefront") — PENDING fix for real app embed status detection
   - `app/routes/app.help.tsx`
     - Fixed broken "Product Rules" false promise — changed to "Coming soon" messaging
     - Added Cart Validator setup step
   - `app/routes/app.tsx`
     - Navigation updated: "Widget" renamed to "Widget Customization"
     - Help & Support added as separate menu item
     - Menu order: Dashboard → Zip Codes → Delivery Rules → Waitlist → Widget Customization → Settings → Help & Support

4. Errors and fixes:
   - `AppBlockMissingSchema` / `Tag 'schema' is missing` error on `cart-validator.liquid`:
     - Shopify Theme Check requires every TAE block to have a `{% schema %}` JSON tag
     - Fix: Read the end of the file (line 187), confirmed no schema tag present, appended the required `{% schema %}{"name": "Cart Validator","target": "section","settings": []}{% endschema %}` block
   - Rate limit hits on builder agents:
     - Multiple agents hit "You've hit your limit" errors mid-execution
     - User confirmed extra usage enabled — resumed work on next message
     - Agent for waitlist notifications was cut off; agent for COD/return policy was cut off
     - User instruction: "keep running and fix from where you left not from start again"

5. Problem Solving:
   - Competitive gap analysis: Identified 8 features to build based on 9 competitor apps
   - Prioritized by effort vs impact: Tier 1 (no DB change) → Tier 2 (1 migration) → Tier 3 (new models) → Tier 4 (analytics)
   - ZIP range import: Capped at 500, numeric-only US ZIPs, upsert pattern, plan limit checking
   - Cart-level blocking: Decided on "soft" client-side approach (sessionStorage + DOM) vs true Shopify Functions (out of scope)
   - Menu order psychology: Applied frequency-first + Gestalt proximity + convention match → only change needed was swapping Help & Support and Settings (Help goes last)
   - App embed status: User wants the "Add widget to storefront" card to show REAL status from Shopify (whether app embed is enabled in the active theme) rather than a manual "I've already added it" button

   - Add an App Embed block to the TAE extension (target: `app_embed`) so merchants can enable/disable the entire app from Theme Editor

Everything is clean. Here is a summary of every change made.

---

## What was built

### Files created

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/app-embed.liquid`**

The new App Embed block. When a merchant enables it from Theme Editor > App Embeds, it injects `window.__zccAppEnabled = true` into the page `<body>`. This is the master on/off toggle for the entire app in a given theme.

---

### Files modified

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/shopify.extension.toml`**

Added a third `[[extensions.blocks]]` entry registering the `app_embed` block type with `target = "body"`. Shopify reads this to surface the toggle in Theme Editor > App Embeds.

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`**

Added an early-return guard at the top of the IIFE:
```javascript
if (!window.__zccAppEnabled) return;

**Bug 1 — Wrong type string to match**

Shopify stores app embed blocks in `settings_data.json` as:
```

```
The `YOUR-PARTNER-HANDLE` comes from your Partners Dashboard app listing, not from `shopify.extension.toml`. It could be `zip-code-checker-123`, `my-zip-app`, or anything else. Checking for `"zip-code-checker"` in the string will never match in most cases.

**Fix**: Match on `.endsWith("/blocks/app-embed")` — this comes from your block *file name* (`blocks/app-embed.liquid`) which is always stable.

**Bug 2 — GraphQL `files` query silently failing**

The `OnlineStoreThemeFileBodyText` union fragment can return `null` body in some themes/API versions (Shopify uses a different internal representation). When it fails, the content is null and `appEmbedEnabled` stays `false` — with no error thrown.

**Fix**: Switched to the REST Admin API endpoint `GET /themes/{id}/assets.json?asset[key]=config/settings_data.json`. This is the canonical, stable way Shopify documents for reading theme files — it always returns the raw file content in `asset.value`.

## What Does NOT Need Extra Scopes

| Operation | Why no scope needed |
|-----------|-------------------|
| `metafieldsSet` on App Installation | App-owned metafields use implicit app permissions — no `write_metaobjects` needed |
| `currentAppInstallation { id }` | Querying your own app's install — always allowed |
| `billing.check()` / `billing.request()` / `billing.cancel()` | The Shopify app framework handles billing with its own implicit permissions — no scope declaration needed |
| All Prisma DB reads/writes | Your own database — no Shopify scope |
| Webhook processing | No scope needed for receiving webhooks |
| Public widget APIs (`api.zip-check`, `api.waitlist`) | Unauthenticated public endpoints — no scope |

| Planned Feature | Scope Needed |
|-----------------|-------------|
| Product-specific ZIP rules (query products) | `read_products` |
| Waitlist email via Shopify Email API | `write_customers` |
| Notify customers via Shopify notifications | `write_customers`, `read_customers` |

import type { HeadersFunction, LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
import { useLoaderData, useNavigate } from "react-router";
import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
import { boundary } from "@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server";
import db from "../db.server";
import { getShopSubscription } from "../billing.server";
import { PLAN_LIMITS } from "../plans";
import {
  Page,
  Layout,
  Card,
  BlockStack,
  InlineStack,
  Text,
  Badge,
  Button,
  Banner,
  InlineGrid,
  Icon,
  Divider,
  ProgressBar,
  Box,
} from "@shopify/polaris";
import {
  SettingsIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  CodeIcon,
  ListBulletedIcon,
  EmailNewsletterIcon,
  LocationIcon,
} from "@shopify/polaris-icons";

export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const shop = session.shop;

  const zipCodes = await db.zipCode.findMany({ where: { shop } });
  const [deliveryRulesCount, waitlistCount, subscription] = await Promise.all([
    db.deliveryRule.count({ where: { shop } }),
    db.waitlistEntry.count({ where: { shop } }),
    getShopSubscription(shop),
  ]);

  const stats = {
    total: zipCodes.length,
    allowed: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.type === "allowed").length,
    blocked: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.type === "blocked").length,
    active: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.isActive).length,
    withEta: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.eta).length,
    zones: [...new Set(zipCodes.map((z) => z.zone).filter(Boolean))].length,
    deliveryRules: deliveryRulesCount,
    waitlist: waitlistCount,
  };

  return { stats, subscription };
};

export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { stats, subscription } = useLoaderData<typeof loader>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const limits = PLAN_LIMITS[subscription.planTier];
  const isFreePlan = subscription.planTier === "free";
  const isEmpty = stats.total === 0;

  const usagePercent =
    limits.maxZipCodes !== Infinity
      ? Math.min(100, Math.round((stats.total / limits.maxZipCodes) * 100))
      : 0;

  const planLabel =
    subscription.planTier === "ultimate"
      ? "Ultimate"
      : subscription.planTier === "pro"
        ? "Pro"
        : "Free";

  const planBadgeTone =
    subscription.planTier === "ultimate"
      ? "attention"
      : subscription.planTier === "pro"
        ? "info"
        : "new";

  return (
    <Page
      title="Dashboard"
      subtitle="Zip Code Checker overview"
      primaryAction={{
        content: "Add Zip Code",
        icon: PlusIcon,
        onAction: () => navigate("/app/zip-codes"),
      }}
    >
      <Box paddingBlockEnd="1600">
        <Layout>

          {/* Upgrade banner — benefit-focused, not plan-name-focused */}
          {isFreePlan && (
            <Layout.Section>
              <Banner
                title="Unlock unlimited zip codes & blocked zones"
                tone="info"
                action={{
                  content: "Upgrade to Pro",
                  onAction: () => navigate("/app/pricing"),
                }}
                secondaryAction={{
                  content: "See all plans",
                  onAction: () => navigate("/app/pricing"),
                }}
              >
                <Text as="p" variant="bodyMd">
                  You're on the Free plan — limited to{" "}
                  {limits.maxZipCodes} allowed zip codes only. Pro unlocks
                  unlimited zip codes, blocked zones, delivery rules, and more.
                </Text>
              </Banner>
            </Layout.Section>
          )}

          {/* Getting started — only when no zip codes added */}
          {isEmpty && (
            <Layout.Section>
              <Card>
                <BlockStack gap="500">
                  <Text as="h2" variant="headingMd">
                    Get started in 3 steps
                  </Text>
                  <Divider />
                  <InlineStack gap="600" blockAlign="start" wrap>
                    <BlockStack gap="150" inlineAlign="start">
                      <Box
                        background="bg-surface-secondary"
                        borderRadius="full"
                        padding="150"
                        width="32px"
                      >
                        <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" fontWeight="bold" alignment="center">
                          1
                        </Text>
                      </Box>
                      <Text as="h3" variant="headingSm">
                        Add your zip codes
                      </Text>
                      <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                        Add delivery areas one by one or import via CSV.
                      </Text>
                      <Button variant="primary" size="slim" onClick={() => navigate("/app/zip-codes")}>
                        Add Zip Codes
                      </Button>
                    </BlockStack>

                    <BlockStack gap="150" inlineAlign="start">
                      <Box
                        background="bg-surface-secondary"
                        borderRadius="full"
                        padding="150"
                        width="32px"
                      >
                        <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" fontWeight="bold" alignment="center">
                          2
                        </Text>
                      </Box>
                      <Text as="h3" variant="headingSm">
                        Customise your widget
                      </Text>
                      <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                        Match the widget to your store's branding.
                      </Text>
                      <Button size="slim" onClick={() => navigate("/app/widget")}>
                        Customise Widget
                      </Button>
                    </BlockStack>

                    <BlockStack gap="150" inlineAlign="start">
                      <Box
                        background="bg-surface-secondary"
                        borderRadius="full"
                        padding="150"
                        width="32px"
                      >
                        <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" fontWeight="bold" alignment="center">
                          3
                        </Text>
                      </Box>
                      <Text as="h3" variant="headingSm">
                        Set delivery rules
                      </Text>
                      <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                        Configure fees, cutoff times, and schedules per zone.
                      </Text>
                      <Button size="slim" onClick={() => navigate("/app/delivery-rules")}>
                        Set Rules
                      </Button>
                    </BlockStack>
                  </InlineStack>
                </BlockStack>
              </Card>
            </Layout.Section>
          )}

          {/* Stats overview — 4 focused metrics only */}
          <Layout.Section>
            <Card>
              <BlockStack gap="400">
                <InlineStack align="space-between" blockAlign="center">
                  <Text as="h2" variant="headingMd">
                    Overview
                  </Text>
                  <Badge tone={planBadgeTone}>{`${planLabel} Plan`}</Badge>
                </InlineStack>
                <Divider />

                <InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 2, sm: 4 }} gap="600">
                  {/* Zip Codes — primary metric */}
                  <BlockStack gap="100">
                    <Text as="p" variant="heading2xl" fontWeight="bold">
                      {stats.total}
                      {limits.maxZipCodes !== Infinity && (
                        <Text as="span" variant="bodyMd" tone="subdued" fontWeight="regular">
                          {" "}/ {limits.maxZipCodes}
                        </Text>
                      )}
                    </Text>
                    <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                      Zip codes
                    </Text>
                  </BlockStack>

                  {/* Allowed */}
                  <BlockStack gap="100">
                    <Text as="p" variant="heading2xl" fontWeight="bold" tone="success">
                      {stats.allowed}
                    </Text>
                    <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                      Allowed zones
                    </Text>
                  </BlockStack>

                  {/* Blocked — subdued on free plan (locked feature), critical on paid */}
                  <BlockStack gap="100">
                    <InlineStack gap="150" blockAlign="center">
                      <Text
                        as="p"
                        variant="heading2xl"
                        fontWeight="bold"
                        tone={isFreePlan ? "subdued" : stats.blocked > 0 ? "critical" : undefined}
                      >
                        {stats.blocked}
                      </Text>
                      {isFreePlan && <Badge tone="attention">Pro+</Badge>}
                    </InlineStack>
                    <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                      Blocked zones
                    </Text>
                  </BlockStack>

                  {/* Waitlist — most actionable: represents potential new customers */}
                  <BlockStack gap="100">
                    <InlineStack gap="150" blockAlign="center">
                      <Text
                        as="p"
                        variant="heading2xl"
                        fontWeight="bold"
                        tone={stats.waitlist > 0 ? "caution" : undefined}
                      >
                        {stats.waitlist}
                      </Text>
                      {stats.waitlist > 0 && (
                        <Badge tone="attention">New</Badge>
                      )}
                    </InlineStack>
                    <InlineStack gap="100" blockAlign="center">
                      <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                        Waitlist entries
                      </Text>
                      {stats.waitlist > 0 && (
                        <Button
                          variant="plain"
                          size="slim"
                          onClick={() => navigate("/app/waitlist")}
                        >
                          View →
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </InlineStack>
                  </BlockStack>
                </InlineGrid>

                {/* Free plan usage bar */}
                {isFreePlan && limits.maxZipCodes !== Infinity && (
                  <>
                    <Divider />
                    <BlockStack gap="200">
                      <InlineStack align="space-between" blockAlign="center">
                        <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="subdued">
                          Plan usage
                        </Text>
                        <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone={usagePercent >= 80 ? "critical" : "subdued"}>
                          {stats.total} / {limits.maxZipCodes} zip codes
                        </Text>
                      </InlineStack>
                      <ProgressBar
                        progress={usagePercent}
                        tone={usagePercent >= 80 ? "critical" : "highlight"}
                        size="small"
                      />
                      {usagePercent >= 80 && (
                        <InlineStack align="space-between" blockAlign="center">
                          <Text as="p" variant="bodySm" tone="critical">
                            {usagePercent === 100
                              ? "Limit reached — upgrade to add more"
                              : "Approaching your zip code limit"}
                          </Text>
                          <Button
                            variant="plain"
                            tone="critical"
                            size="slim"
                            onClick={() => navigate("/app/pricing")}
                          >
                            Upgrade now
                          </Button>
                        </InlineStack>
                      )}
                    </BlockStack>
                  </>
                )}
              </BlockStack>
            </Card>
          </Layout.Section>

          {/* Quick Actions — clear hierarchy: primary action prominent, others secondary */}
          <Layout.Section>
            <BlockStack gap="300">
              <Text as="h2" variant="headingMd">
                Quick Actions
              </Text>
              <InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 2, md: 3 }} gap="400">

                <Card>
                  <BlockStack gap="300">
                    <Box
                      background="bg-surface-secondary"
                      borderRadius="200"
                      padding="300"
                      width="fit-content"

  ]);

  const stats = {
    total: zipCodes.length,
    allowed: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.type === "allowed").length,
    blocked: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.type === "blocked").length,
    active: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.isActive).length,
    withEta: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.eta).length,
    zones: [...new Set(zipCodes.map((z) => z.zone).filter(Boolean))].length,
    deliveryRules: deliveryRulesCount,
    waitlist: waitlistCount,
  };

  // Detect whether the App Embed is enabled in the active theme
  let appEmbedEnabled = false;
  let activeThemeName: string | null = null;

export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const shop = session.shop;

  const zipCodes = await db.zipCode.findMany({ where: { shop } });
  const [deliveryRulesCount, waitlistCount, subscription] = await Promise.all([
    db.deliveryRule.count({ where: { shop } }),
    db.waitlistEntry.count({ where: { shop } }),
    getShopSubscription(shop),
  ]);

  const stats = {
    total: zipCodes.length,
    allowed: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.type === "allowed").length,
    blocked: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.type === "blocked").length,
    active: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.isActive).length,
    withEta: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.eta).length,
    zones: [...new Set(zipCodes.map((z) => z.zone).filter(Boolean))].length,
    deliveryRules: deliveryRulesCount,
    waitlist: waitlistCount,
  };

  // Detect whether the App Embed is enabled in the active theme
  let appEmbedEnabled = false;
  let activeThemeName: string | null = null;
  let themeEditorUrl = `https://${shop}/admin/themes/current/editor`;
  let themeEditorAppEmbedsUrl = `https://${shop}/admin/themes/current/editor?context=apps`;

  try {
    const themesRes = await fetch(
      `https://${shop}/admin/api/2026-01/themes.json?role=main`,
      { headers: { "X-Shopify-Access-Token": session.accessToken ?? "" } },
    );
    if (themesRes.ok) {
      const themesJson = (await themesRes.json()) as {
        themes?: { id: number; name: string }[];
      };
      const mainTheme = themesJson.themes?.[0];
      if (mainTheme) {
        const numericId = String(mainTheme.id);
        activeThemeName = mainTheme.name;
        themeEditorUrl = `https://${shop}/admin/themes/${numericId}/editor`;
        themeEditorAppEmbedsUrl = `https://${shop}/admin/themes/${numericId}/editor?context=apps`;

        const assetRes = await fetch(
          `https://${shop}/admin/api/2026-01/themes/${numericId}/assets.json?asset%5Bkey%5D=config%2Fsettings_data.json`,
          { headers: { "X-Shopify-Access-Token": session.accessToken ?? "" } },
        );
        if (assetRes.ok) {
          const assetJson = (await assetRes.json()) as {
            asset?: { value?: string };
          };
          const content = assetJson?.asset?.value;
          if (content) {
            const settingsData = JSON.parse(content) as {
              current?: { blocks?: Record<string, unknown> };
            };
            const blocks = settingsData?.current?.blocks ?? {};
            appEmbedEnabled = Object.values(blocks).some((block) => {
              const b = block as { type?: string; disabled?: boolean };
              return (
                typeof b.type === "string" &&
                (b.type.includes("app-embed") || b.type.includes("app_embed")) &&
                b.disabled !== true
              );
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal — embed status defaults to false
  }

  return {
    stats,
    subscription,
    appEmbedEnabled,
    activeThemeName,
    themeEditorUrl,
    themeEditorAppEmbedsUrl,
  };
};

import type { HeadersFunction, LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
import { useLoaderData, useNavigate, useRevalidator } from "react-router";
import { authenticate } from "../shopify.server";
import { boundary } from "@shopify/shopify-app-react-router/server";
import db from "../db.server";
import { getShopSubscription } from "../billing.server";
import { PLAN_LIMITS } from "../plans";
import {
  Page,
  Layout,
  Card,
  BlockStack,
  InlineStack,
  Text,
  Badge,
  Button,
  Banner,
  InlineGrid,
  Icon,
  Divider,
  ProgressBar,
  Box,
} from "@shopify/polaris";
import {
  SettingsIcon,
  PlusIcon,
  CodeIcon,
  ListBulletedIcon,
  EmailNewsletterIcon,
  LocationIcon,
  ExternalIcon,
} from "@shopify/polaris-icons";

export const loader = async ({ request }: LoaderFunctionArgs) => {
  const { session } = await authenticate.admin(request);
  const shop = session.shop;

  const zipCodes = await db.zipCode.findMany({ where: { shop } });
  const [deliveryRulesCount, waitlistCount, subscription] = await Promise.all([
    db.deliveryRule.count({ where: { shop } }),
    db.waitlistEntry.count({ where: { shop } }),
    getShopSubscription(shop),
  ]);

  const stats = {
    total: zipCodes.length,
    allowed: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.type === "allowed").length,
    blocked: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.type === "blocked").length,
    active: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.isActive).length,
    withEta: zipCodes.filter((z) => z.eta).length,
    zones: [...new Set(zipCodes.map((z) => z.zone).filter(Boolean))].length,
    deliveryRules: deliveryRulesCount,
    waitlist: waitlistCount,
  };

  // Detect whether the App Embed is enabled in the active theme
  let appEmbedEnabled = false;
  let activeThemeName: string | null = null;
  let themeEditorUrl = `https://${shop}/admin/themes/current/editor`;
  let themeEditorAppEmbedsUrl = `https://${shop}/admin/themes/current/editor?context=apps`;

  try {
    const themesRes = await fetch(
      `https://${shop}/admin/api/2026-01/themes.json?role=main`,
      { headers: { "X-Shopify-Access-Token": session.accessToken ?? "" } },
    );
    if (themesRes.ok) {
      const themesJson = (await themesRes.json()) as {
        themes?: { id: number; name: string }[];
      };
      const mainTheme = themesJson.themes?.[0];
      if (mainTheme) {
        const numericId = String(mainTheme.id);
        activeThemeName = mainTheme.name;
        themeEditorUrl = `https://${shop}/admin/themes/${numericId}/editor`;
        themeEditorAppEmbedsUrl = `https://${shop}/admin/themes/${numericId}/editor?context=apps`;

        const assetRes = await fetch(
          `https://${shop}/admin/api/2026-01/themes/${numericId}/assets.json?asset%5Bkey%5D=config%2Fsettings_data.json`,
          { headers: { "X-Shopify-Access-Token": session.accessToken ?? "" } },
        );
        if (assetRes.ok) {
          const assetJson = (await assetRes.json()) as {
            asset?: { value?: string };
          };
          const content = assetJson?.asset?.value;
          if (content) {
            const settingsData = JSON.parse(content) as {
              current?: { blocks?: Record<string, unknown> };
            };
            const blocks = settingsData?.current?.blocks ?? {};
            appEmbedEnabled = Object.values(blocks).some((block) => {
              const b = block as { type?: string; disabled?: boolean };
              return (
                typeof b.type === "string" &&
                (b.type.includes("app-embed") || b.type.includes("app_embed")) &&
                b.disabled !== true
              );
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Non-fatal — embed status defaults to false
  }

  return {
    stats,
    subscription,
    appEmbedEnabled,
    activeThemeName,
    themeEditorUrl,
    themeEditorAppEmbedsUrl,
  };
};

export default function DashboardPage() {

  const navigate = useNavigate();

# Dashboard UX Audit — Full Change List

## Context
User requested a full UX audit of the Dashboard page (`app/routes/app._index.tsx`) with the goal of making it high-converting, easy to adopt for new users, and minimal. No code changes yet — this is the full list of recommended improvements only.

---

## Audit Findings & Recommended Changes

### 1. STOREFRONT STATUS CARD

**Current problems:**
- Step 1 and Step 2 boxes sit inside the status card with no visual separation from the card header — they blend together
- When NOT active, the warning banner AND the two step boxes AND the instruction text below all stack vertically inside the card — too much nesting inside a single card
- When active, "Manage App Embeds" and "Edit Widget in Theme" are plain buttons with no context — a new merchant won't know what either does at a glance
- The "Refresh" button is plain text next to the badge — low discoverability, no visual cue that it updates the status

**Recommended changes:**
- **Active state**: Replace the two plain buttons with a single clean line: badge "Active" (green) + theme name + one "Open Theme Editor ↗" link. Remove "Manage App Embeds" button — it's for power users only and clutters the active state
- **Not active state**: Move the two setup steps OUT of the warning banner. Keep the card header (title + badge + refresh). Show a simple numbered list below the Divider — no nested boxes, just two rows with a number, bold label, one-line description, and a link inline. This reduces visual weight significantly
- **Refresh button**: Make it a `Button` with `size="slim"` and `variant="tertiary"` instead of `variant="plain"` so it has a visible affordance (border/outline)
- **Card title**: Change "Storefront Status" → "App Status" — shorter, cleaner, matches Shopify's own app home card naming

---

### 2. UPGRADE BANNER (Free plan only)

**Current problems:**
- Shows BELOW the status card — merchants on free plan who haven't set up the app see: Status Card → Upgrade Banner → Getting Started Card → Stats. Too much content before they can act
- The banner text is verbose: "You're on the Free plan — limited to X allowed zip codes only. Pro unlocks unlimited zip codes, blocked zones, delivery rules, and more." Reads like a sales pitch, not helpful guidance
- Two actions both go to the same page (`/app/pricing`) — duplicate, one is enough
- Shows even after merchant has zip codes and is happily using the free plan — should only show when they're approaching or at the limit

**Recommended changes:**
- **Move** upgrade banner to BELOW the stats card (after metrics are shown) — merchant sees their data first, then the upgrade prompt in context
- **Conditionalize**: Only show when `usagePercent >= 60` (approaching limit) instead of always showing for all free users
- **Shorten text**: "You've used {stats.total} of {limits.maxZipCodes} zip codes. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited." — one sentence
- **Single action**: Remove secondary "See all plans" — "Upgrade to Pro" is sufficient

---

### 3. GETTING STARTED CARD (empty state)

**Current problems:**
- `InlineStack` with `gap="600"` and `wrap` for the 3 steps — on mobile the steps collapse into a vertical stack but each step has no visual separation (no divider, no card background). They all blur together
- Step numbering uses a `Box` with `background="bg-surface-secondary"` + `borderRadius="full"` but it's the same grey as the card background — numbers are barely visible
- Step 2 button ("Customise Widget") is `variant` default (outline) while Step 1 is `variant="primary"` — good hierarchy. But Step 3 ("Set Rules") is also default — Step 1 being primary is correct but shouldn't all non-primary steps look the same? They do, that's fine. No change needed here
- The card title "Get started in 3 steps" is fine BUT the card shows even when the app embed is already active AND zip codes are empty — the first action for a merchant who just enabled the embed should be "Add zip codes", not a full 3-step guide

**Recommended changes:**
- **Use `InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 3 }}`** instead of `InlineStack wrap` — gives each step a defined column regardless of screen size, prevents uneven wrapping
- **Step number circles**: Change `background="bg-surface-secondary"` → `background="bg-fill-brand"` with `tone="text-inverse"` for the number text — makes the 1/2/3 circles visually pop (dark background, white number)
- **Card appears only when `isEmpty`** — already correct. But when `isEmpty && appEmbedEnabled`, reorder: show Step 1 ("Add Zip Codes") as the only primary focus, visually heavier. Currently fine but step 1 is primary — keep as is
- **Add a dismissable state**: Once a merchant has clicked any step button, the "Get started" card should collapse or show a "Setup complete" note. Currently it never goes away until `stats.total > 0`. Consider keeping as-is since it disappears naturally once zips are added

---

### 4. STATS OVERVIEW CARD

**Current problems:**
- "Overview" title is generic — tells the merchant nothing about what they're looking at
- Plan badge ("Free Plan", "Pro Plan") is inside the stats card header — a plan badge belongs in the page header or in a dedicated plan card, not mixed with the metrics. It creates visual noise
- The 4 metrics (Zip codes, Allowed zones, Blocked zones, Waitlist entries) use `heading2xl` for numbers — these are very large. On the Polaris scale `heading2xl` is ~28px. This is fine for a dashboard but feels heavy alongside `bodySm` labels
- Blocked zones stat shows a "Pro+" badge inline with the metric number on free plan — this is confusing. A merchant sees "0 Pro+" and doesn't immediately understand it means "this feature is locked"
- The waitlist "New" badge is `tone="new"` (purple) on the metric number itself — badge sits inline with the number which is not standard Polaris pattern
- "Waitlist entries" metric label is verbose — should be "On Waitlist"

**Recommended changes:**
- **Card title**: Change "Overview" → "Your Numbers" OR just remove the title entirely — the stats speak for themselves. Most Shopify app dashboards use no title on the stats row
- **Move plan badge**: Remove from stats card header. Put it as a subtitle in the `Page` component's `subtitle` prop or as a small badge next to the page title. E.g., `subtitle="Free Plan · 3 zip codes"`
- **Blocked zones badge**: Replace inline "Pro+" badge with a `Tooltip` on the stat or a lock icon next to the label — "Blocked zones 🔒" is cleaner than "0 Pro+"
- **Waitlist badge**: Move "New" badge ABOVE the number (as a standalone row) or use a separate small `Text` line below the metric label ("3 new since last visit") — not inline with the number
- **Label fix**: "Waitlist entries" → "On waitlist"

## Feature Implementation Plan

### Feature 1 — Disable Add to Cart / Buy Now
**Decision:** Client-side DOM manipulation in the widget liquid. No new scopes required.
**Approach:** After zip check, widget fires a custom event + sets `sessionStorage` + directly disables matching buttons.

**What to build:**

    - When `data.allowed === false`: query DOM for ATC/BuyNow buttons and disable them + set tooltip
    - When `data.allowed === true`: re-enable buttons and remove tooltip
  - Button selectors to target (covers all major Shopify themes):

    button[name="add"], .product-form__submit, [data-product-add],
    .btn--add-to-cart, .product-form button[type="submit"],
    button.shopify-payment-button__button, .shopify-payment-button button
    ```
  - Disabled state: `button.disabled = true`, `button.style.opacity = "0.4"`, `button.title = "Enter a valid ZIP code to continue"`

### Feature 2 — Global ZIP/Postal Code Format Support
**Decision:** Pure normalization logic, no DB changes, no new settings for initial implementation. Auto-detect format and normalize silently.

**Normalization rules (applied in BOTH widget and API):**
| Format | Normalization |
|--------|--------------|
| US ZIP+4 (90210-1234) | Strip `-XXXX` suffix → `90210` |
| UK (sw1a 2aa) | Uppercase + collapse spaces → `SW1A2AA` for lookup (store without space) |
| India (400 001) | Remove spaces → `400001` |
| Canada (m5h 2n2) | Uppercase + remove space → `M5H2N2` for lookup |
| Australia (2 000) | Remove spaces → `2000` |
| All | `.trim().toUpperCase()`, collapse internal whitespace |

**What to build:**
- New utility function `normalizeZipCode(raw: string): string` in `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx` (or a shared utility):
  ```typescript
  function normalizeZipCode(raw: string): string {
    let z = raw.trim().toUpperCase();
    z = z.replace(/\s+/g, '');       // collapse all spaces
    z = z.replace(/-\d{4}$/, '');    // strip US ZIP+4 suffix
    return z;
  }
  ```
- Apply `normalizeZipCode()` BEFORE the DB lookup in `api.zip-check.tsx`
- In the widget JS (`zip-code-checker.liquid`): normalize the displayed input before sending:
  - Strip ZIP+4 suffix, collapse whitespace, uppercase
  - Update `inp.value` with the normalized form on check (UX: input cleans itself)
- In `api.waitlist.tsx`: apply same normalization to the `zip` parameter

**Files:**
- `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx`
- `app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx`
- `extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`

# Competitive Feature Roadmap — Zip Code Checker

## Context
Based on deep competitive analysis of 9 Shopify ZIP code apps (Zippy, Zipprover, SB Validator, OC Pincode, Easy Zipcode Check, Smart Zipcode Tracker, Advanced Zipcode Validator/AppJetty) vs our current app. Goal: identify the highest-ROI ZIP-code-specific features to build, avoid scope creep (no shipping rates, no checkout restrictions, no cart functions), and match or exceed the market leader (AppJetty, 5.0/65 reviews).

---

## Where We Currently Stand

**Our strengths vs competitors:**
- Best delivery rules system (cutoff times, min order, free shipping threshold, day-of-week, priority) — AppJetty doesn't have this level of rule detail
- Waitlist capture (only AppJetty and Easy Zipcode Check have this)
- 3 widget positions (inline / floating / popup)
- Custom CSS injection (nobody else has this)
- Zone-based organization with unlimited zips (Pro)
- Custom message per zip code

**Competitive gaps (ZIP-code-specific only):**
| Feature | Zippy | Zipprover | AppJetty | Us |
|---------|-------|-----------|----------|-----|
| COD availability per zip | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Return/Exchange policy per zip | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Show cutoff time in widget | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ (data exists!) |
| Show delivery days in widget | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ (data exists!) |
| Product/collection-specific rules | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| ZIP range import (10001–10099) | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Waitlist email notifications | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ (none have this!) |
| Analytics dashboard | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ (differentiation opportunity) |
| ZIP prefix/wildcard matching | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |

---

## Recommended Feature Roadmap

Features are ranked by: competitive impact × implementation effort × app vision fit.
**NOT included:** shipping rate calculation, checkout restrictions, cart blocking, inventory sync — outside ZIP code app scope.

---

### TIER 1 — Quick Wins (Zero to minimal DB changes)

#### 1.1 Show Cutoff Time + Delivery Days in Widget
**Why:** We ALREADY store `cutoffTime` and `daysOfWeek` on `DeliveryRule` but never display them. AppJetty shows "Order before 2:00 PM for same-day delivery" and "Delivers Mon–Fri." This is a ZERO database change — just needs API + widget updates.
**Impact:** Major UX upgrade. Customers see actionable info ("Order by 2 PM today!").
**Changes needed:**
- `api.zip-check.tsx` — include `cutoffTime` and `daysOfWeek` from matching DeliveryRule in response
- `extensions/.../zip-code-checker.liquid` — render cutoff time + days below success message
- `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` — add `showCutoffTime` and `showDeliveryDays` toggles to WidgetConfig

#### 1.2 ZIP Code Range Import
**Why:** AppJetty offers this. Merchants covering metro areas (e.g., NYC 10001–10299) would have to add 299 zips manually or build a CSV. Range import is a massive time saver. Very common request.
**Impact:** Removes a major friction point for new merchants onboarding bulk data.
**Changes needed:**
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — no change
- `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` — new "Import Range" section in import modal: two inputs (Start ZIP, End ZIP) + Status + Zone + Message. Server-side generates all numeric zips in range and bulk-upserts. Cap at 500 per range to prevent abuse.
- Validation: both zips must be 5-digit numeric, end must be ≥ start, range capped at 500.

---

### TIER 2 — Database Additions (High competitive value)

#### 2.1 COD (Cash on Delivery) Availability per ZIP Code
**Why:** AppJetty and Zipprover both show COD eligibility. This is huge in Indian, Middle Eastern, and Southeast Asian markets. No DB migration risk — just adding a nullable boolean field.
**Impact:** Unlocks an entirely new merchant segment (D2C brands in India/MENA).
**Changes needed:**
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — add `codAvailable Boolean?` to `ZipCode` model
- New migration: `add_cod_return_policy_to_zipcode`
- `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` — add COD toggle in add/edit modal; show COD badge in table
- `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx` — include `codAvailable` in response
- `extensions/.../zip-code-checker.liquid` — show "COD Available" / "COD Not Available" badge
- `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` — add `showCod` toggle to widget config

#### 2.2 Return/Exchange Policy Text per ZIP Code
**Why:** AppJetty and Zipprover show return policies per zip. High-value for merchants with region-specific return centers.
**Impact:** Differentiates us from Zippy and SB Validator which have no return policy display.
**Changes needed:**
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — add `returnPolicy String?` to `ZipCode` model (same migration as 2.1)
- `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` — add Return Policy textarea in add/edit modal
- `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx` — include `returnPolicy` in response
- `extensions/.../zip-code-checker.liquid` — show return policy text below success message
- `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` — add `showReturnPolicy` toggle

#### 2.3 Waitlist Email Notifications
**Why:** NO competitor has automated waitlist notifications. This is a genuine market differentiator. When a merchant adds a new ZIP code (or activates a blocked one), they can notify all waitlisted customers for that ZIP with a single click.
**Impact:** Makes the waitlist feature 10x more valuable — it becomes a re-engagement tool, not just a list.
**Note:** Does not require an external email service initially — use Shopify's Email API (via admin.graphql), or just generate a mailto: link as MVP, full email service in v2.
**Changes needed:**
- `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` — "Notify Waitlist" button per ZIP that sends a notification email to all `status: "waiting"` entries for that zip; updates status to "notified"
- `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx` — when a blocked ZIP is looked up, optionally trigger background check if merchant has waitlist entries
- Shopify Email approach (MVP): use `window.location.href = mailto:...` with pre-filled subject/body, or use nodemailer/Resend API

---

### TIER 3 — Architecture Additions (Major differentiators)

#### 3.1 Product/Collection-Specific ZIP Rules
**Why:** Zippy, Zipprover, and AppJetty all offer this. A merchant may deliver fridges only to certain ZIPs while delivering small items everywhere. Currently we only have global + zone-level rules.
**Impact:** Unlocks merchants with multi-category product lines.
**How (without requiring `read_products` Shopify scope):** The widget passes the current product ID/handle from the Liquid context. The admin lets merchants create "Product Rules" by entering product IDs or handles manually. No API scope needed — merchant knows their own product IDs.
**Changes needed:**
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — new `ProductRule` model: `{ id, shop, productId, productHandle, productTitle, allowedZips String, blockedZips String, isActive, priority }`
- New migration
- New route: `app/routes/app.product-rules.tsx` — CRUD for product-level rules
- `extensions/.../zip-code-checker.liquid` — read `{{ product.id }}` from Liquid context; pass as `data-product-id` attribute; widget sends product ID with zip check
- `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx` — if `productId` is sent, check ProductRule table first (higher priority than global rules)
- `app.tsx` navigation — add "Product Rules" nav link

#### 3.2 ZIP Prefix / Wildcard Matching
**Why:** No competitor offers this. Allows merchants to type `100*` and match all US zips starting with 100 (New York area). Eliminates bulk entry for large regions.
**Impact:** Merchants covering entire states or regions can set up in seconds instead of importing thousands of ZIPs.
**How:** Store wildcard entries as-is (e.g., `100*`, `SW1*`). In the API query, if no exact match is found, check wildcard entries with a `LIKE` query pattern.
**Changes needed:**
- `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx` — after exact match fails, query `db.zipCode.findMany({ where: { shop, zipCode: { startsWith: prefix } } })` for each wildcard pattern stored
- `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` — badge wildcards differently in the table; validate that wildcard entries end with `*` and have at least 2 chars before the wildcard

---

### TIER 4 — Analytics Dashboard (Long-term retention)
**Why:** No competitor offers analytics. Merchants who can see "1,247 zip checks last week, 89% success rate, top 5 blocked zips: 90210, 33101..." will never churn.
**New model:** `ZipCheckEvent { id, shop, zipCode, result (allowed/blocked/notfound), createdAt }` — logged on every API call.
**Admin page:** `app/routes/app.analytics.tsx` — daily check volume chart, success rate, top checked zips, top blocked zips, conversion funnel (checks → waitlist signups).
**Note:** Requires careful DB sizing decisions (add TTL/cleanup job for old events). Plan behind Pro/Ultimate plan gate.

---

## Implementation Order (Recommended)

| Priority | Feature | Effort | DB Change | Competitive Position |
|----------|---------|--------|-----------|---------------------|
| 1 | Cutoff time + delivery days in widget | Small | None | Match AppJetty |
| 2 | ZIP range import | Small | None | Match AppJetty |
| 3 | COD + Return policy per zip | Medium | 1 migration | Match Zipprover + AppJetty |
| 4 | Waitlist email notifications | Medium | None | Beat ALL competitors |
| 5 | Product-specific ZIP rules | Large | New model | Match top 3 competitors |
| 6 | Analytics dashboard | Large | New model | Beat ALL competitors |
| 7 | ZIP wildcard matching | Medium | None | Beat ALL competitors |

---

## Critical Files for Implementation
- `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` — range import + COD/return fields
- `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` — notification system
- `app/routes/app.widget.tsx` — new toggle fields
- `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx` — new response fields
- `extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` — widget display
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — COD + return policy fields (Tier 2)
- New: `app/routes/app.product-rules.tsx` (Tier 3)
- New: `app/routes/app.analytics.tsx` (Tier 4)

---

## What We're NOT Building
- Shipping rate calculation (different product category)
- Checkout-level blocking (requires Shopify Functions — different architecture)
- Cart-level restriction (requires Checkout Extensions)
- Inventory sync (outside ZIP code app scope)
- Social proof/sharing (not ZIP-code related)

# Dashboard UX Audit — Full Change List

## Context
User requested a full UX audit of the Dashboard page (`app/routes/app._index.tsx`) with the goal of making it high-converting, easy to adopt for new users, and minimal. No code changes yet — this is the full list of recommended improvements only.

---

## Audit Findings & Recommended Changes

### 1. STOREFRONT STATUS CARD

**Current problems:**
- Step 1 and Step 2 boxes sit inside the status card with no visual separation from the card header — they blend together
- When NOT active, the warning banner AND the two step boxes AND the instruction text below all stack vertically inside the card — too much nesting inside a single card
- When active, "Manage App Embeds" and "Edit Widget in Theme" are plain buttons with no context — a new merchant won't know what either does at a glance
- The "Refresh" button is plain text next to the badge — low discoverability, no visual cue that it updates the status

**Recommended changes:**
- **Active state**: Replace the two plain buttons with a single clean line: badge "Active" (green) + theme name + one "Open Theme Editor ↗" link. Remove "Manage App Embeds" button — it's for power users only and clutters the active state
- **Not active state**: Move the two setup steps OUT of the warning banner. Keep the card header (title + badge + refresh). Show a simple numbered list below the Divider — no nested boxes, just two rows with a number, bold label, one-line description, and a link inline. This reduces visual weight significantly
- **Refresh button**: Make it a `Button` with `size="slim"` and `variant="tertiary"` instead of `variant="plain"` so it has a visible affordance (border/outline)
- **Card title**: Change "Storefront Status" → "App Status" — shorter, cleaner, matches Shopify's own app home card naming

---

### 2. UPGRADE BANNER (Free plan only)

**Current problems:**
- Shows BELOW the status card — merchants on free plan who haven't set up the app see: Status Card → Upgrade Banner → Getting Started Card → Stats. Too much content before they can act
- The banner text is verbose: "You're on the Free plan — limited to X allowed zip codes only. Pro unlocks unlimited zip codes, blocked zones, delivery rules, and more." Reads like a sales pitch, not helpful guidance
- Two actions both go to the same page (`/app/pricing`) — duplicate, one is enough
- Shows even after merchant has zip codes and is happily using the free plan — should only show when they're approaching or at the limit

**Recommended changes:**
- **Move** upgrade banner to BELOW the stats card (after metrics are shown) — merchant sees their data first, then the upgrade prompt in context
- **Conditionalize**: Only show when `usagePercent >= 60` (approaching limit) instead of always showing for all free users
- **Shorten text**: "You've used {stats.total} of {limits.maxZipCodes} zip codes. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited." — one sentence
- **Single action**: Remove secondary "See all plans" — "Upgrade to Pro" is sufficient

---

### 3. GETTING STARTED CARD (empty state)

**Current problems:**
- `InlineStack` with `gap="600"` and `wrap` for the 3 steps — on mobile the steps collapse into a vertical stack but each step has no visual separation (no divider, no card background). They all blur together
- Step numbering uses a `Box` with `background="bg-surface-secondary"` + `borderRadius="full"` but it's the same grey as the card background — numbers are barely visible
- Step 2 button ("Customise Widget") is `variant` default (outline) while Step 1 is `variant="primary"` — good hierarchy. But Step 3 ("Set Rules") is also default — Step 1 being primary is correct but shouldn't all non-primary steps look the same? They do, that's fine. No change needed here
- The card title "Get started in 3 steps" is fine BUT the card shows even when the app embed is already active AND zip codes are empty — the first action for a merchant who just enabled the embed should be "Add zip codes", not a full 3-step guide

**Recommended changes:**
- **Use `InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 3 }}`** instead of `InlineStack wrap` — gives each step a defined column regardless of screen size, prevents uneven wrapping
- **Step number circles**: Change `background="bg-surface-secondary"` → `background="bg-fill-brand"` with `tone="text-inverse"` for the number text — makes the 1/2/3 circles visually pop (dark background, white number)
- **Card appears only when `isEmpty`** — already correct. But when `isEmpty && appEmbedEnabled`, reorder: show Step 1 ("Add Zip Codes") as the only primary focus, visually heavier. Currently fine but step 1 is primary — keep as is
- **Add a dismissable state**: Once a merchant has clicked any step button, the "Get started" card should collapse or show a "Setup complete" note. Currently it never goes away until `stats.total > 0`. Consider keeping as-is since it disappears naturally once zips are added

---

### 4. STATS OVERVIEW CARD

**Current problems:**
- "Overview" title is generic — tells the merchant nothing about what they're looking at
- Plan badge ("Free Plan", "Pro Plan") is inside the stats card header — a plan badge belongs in the page header or in a dedicated plan card, not mixed with the metrics. It creates visual noise
- The 4 metrics (Zip codes, Allowed zones, Blocked zones, Waitlist entries) use `heading2xl` for numbers — these are very large. On the Polaris scale `heading2xl` is ~28px. This is fine for a dashboard but feels heavy alongside `bodySm` labels
- Blocked zones stat shows a "Pro+" badge inline with the metric number on free plan — this is confusing. A merchant sees "0 Pro+" and doesn't immediately understand it means "this feature is locked"
- The waitlist "New" badge is `tone="new"` (purple) on the metric number itself — badge sits inline with the number which is not standard Polaris pattern
- "Waitlist entries" metric label is verbose — should be "On Waitlist"

**Recommended changes:**
- **Card title**: Change "Overview" → "Your Numbers" OR just remove the title entirely — the stats speak for themselves. Most Shopify app dashboards use no title on the stats row
- **Move plan badge**: Remove from stats card header. Put it as a subtitle in the `Page` component's `subtitle` prop or as a small badge next to the page title. E.g., `subtitle="Free Plan · 3 zip codes"`
- **Blocked zones badge**: Replace inline "Pro+" badge with a `Tooltip` on the stat or a lock icon next to the label — "Blocked zones 🔒" is cleaner than "0 Pro+"
- **Waitlist badge**: Move "New" badge ABOVE the number (as a standalone row) or use a separate small `Text` line below the metric label ("3 new since last visit") — not inline with the number
- **Label fix**: "Waitlist entries" → "On waitlist"
- **Delivery Rules metric**: Currently in the stats object (`stats.deliveryRules`) but NOT displayed in the 4-column grid — it's tracked but invisible. Either add it as a 5th metric or remove it from the loader. Currently wasted data

---

### 5. PLAN USAGE BAR (free plan only)

**Current problems:**
- Shows INSIDE the stats card at the bottom — it's part of the Overview card but styled differently, creating an inconsistent card section
- The progress bar label "Plan usage" is redundant — the bar itself shows the numbers
- At <80% usage: no warning shown, just the bar. Fine.
- At ≥80%: shows warning text AND an "Upgrade now" button — but the upgrade banner ABOVE already has an "Upgrade to Pro" button. The merchant now has two upgrade CTAs on screen at the same time

**Recommended changes:**
- **Move usage bar OUT of the stats card**: Put it as its own slim card or as a `Banner` at the top of the stats section — keeps the stats card clean (numbers only)
- **Remove duplicate upgrade CTA**: When usage ≥ 80%, the existing upgrade banner (once moved below stats) handles the CTA. Remove the "Upgrade now" button from inside the stats card
- **Simplify label**: Just show "{stats.total} / {limits.maxZipCodes} zip codes used" — no "Plan usage" header needed

---

### 6. QUICK ACTIONS SECTION

**Current problems:**
- 5 cards in a `xs:1, sm:2, md:3` grid — on tablet (sm) you get 2 columns with the 5th card spanning alone on the last row. Asymmetric grid looks unfinished
- All 5 cards have the same visual weight — no hierarchy. "Manage Zip Codes" is the most important action but looks identical to "Settings & Billing" which is rarely used
- Each card has: Icon → H3 → subtext → Button. The button just says "Manage Zip Codes" etc. — same text as the heading. Redundant
- "Settings & Billing" card name is confusing — settings and billing are two different concerns. Billing is important (upgrade), settings is secondary
- Icons are all the same size/style which is good, but the cards feel dense with 4 elements each

**Recommended changes:**
- **Change to `xs:1, sm:2, md:2` for bottom section + special treatment for "Manage Zip Codes"**: Make the ZIP codes card full-width or visually primary (larger, different background) at the top, then 2x2 grid for the remaining 4. This creates clear hierarchy
- **Remove the button from each card**: The entire card is clickable (via `onClick` on the card). Remove the `Button` inside and make the card itself the click target. Cleaner, less cluttered. Add a chevron icon (→) at the top-right of each card instead
- **Split "Settings & Billing"**: Rename to just "Settings" — billing/upgrade is handled by the upgrade banner. The card can link to `/app/settings`
- **Add metric previews to cards**: The ZIP codes card already shows the count on the dashboard stats. Repeat a small stat inside the relevant quick action card (e.g., "Manage Zip Codes" card shows "47 active" in subdued text below the heading). This gives merchants a reason to notice/click
- **Section title**: Current section has no title. Add `Text variant="headingSm"` label "Quick Actions" above the grid, OR remove the label entirely and let the cards stand alone. "Quick Actions" as a label is redundant — remove it

---

### 7. PAGE-LEVEL STRUCTURE

**Current problems:**
- The page `subtitle` is "Zip Code Checker overview" — generic, wastes the subtitle slot
- No page-level plan indicator — merchant can't tell at a glance what plan they're on without looking inside a card
- `primaryAction` is "Add Zip Code" with `PlusIcon` — correct for the primary action, keep as-is
- The overall section order is: Status Card → Upgrade Banner → Getting Started → Stats → Quick Actions. This order has two interruptions before the merchant reaches their actual data (stats)

**Recommended new section order:**
1. **App Status card** (always first — Shopify pattern)
2. **Stats card** (merchant's data — second most important)
3. **Usage bar** (contextual to stats, slim)
4. **Upgrade banner** (only when approaching/at limit — after data gives it context)
5. **Getting Started** (only when empty)
6. **Quick Actions** (always last — navigation shortcuts)

---

### 8. EMPTY STATE (no zip codes yet)

**Current problems:**
- When `isEmpty === true`: the Stats card shows all zeros (0, 0, 0, 0). Showing a stats card full of zeros is demotivating and confusing for a new user
- The Getting Started card + an all-zero stats card on the same screen is redundant — the getting started guide is enough

**Recommended changes:**
- **Hide the stats card entirely when `isEmpty === true`** — show only: Status card → Getting Started card → Quick Actions
- **Hide the upgrade banner when `isEmpty === true`** — a brand new user doesn't need a sales pitch before they've added a single zip code

---

## Files to Modify

| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `app/routes/app._index.tsx` | All UI changes above — single file |

No DB changes, no new routes, no API changes required.

---

## Summary of Change Count

| Category | # Changes |
|----------|-----------|
| Storefront Status card | 4 |
| Upgrade banner | 4 |
| Getting Started card | 2 |
| Stats Overview card | 5 |
| Plan Usage bar | 3 |
| Quick Actions | 4 |
| Page structure / order | 2 |
| Empty state | 2 |
| **Total** | **26 improvements** |

Zero errors. Here's what changed in this rewrite vs the previous version:

**App Status** — Active state is now a clean `Banner tone="success"` (not a full Card with buttons). Not-active state uses two side-by-side `Card` components inside the setup card with `Badge` step labels ("Step 1", "Step 2") — cleaner than numbered circles with Box hacks.

**Stats** — Uses `headingXl` instead of `heading2xl` (less overwhelming), usage bar stays INSIDE the stats card below a `Divider` (it belongs with the metrics contextually), shows percentage on the right.

**Getting Started** — Each step is inside a `Box` with `bg-surface-secondary` background and rounded corners, with the step number + title on one line using `InlineStack`. Data-driven via `.map()` — no repeated JSX blocks.

**Navigation** — Clean 4-column grid of small Cards (not UnstyledButton wrappers). Each card: title + optional `Badge` with live stat + description + "Manage" button. No icons, no chevrons, no Box padding hacks. Simple and minimal.

**Removed** — `UnstyledButton`, `Tooltip`, `ChevronRightIcon`, `LocationIcon`, `CodeIcon`, `ListBulletedIcon`, `EmailNewsletterIcon`, `SettingsIcon`, `Icon` component. Uses `BlockStack gap="500"` instead of `Layout` + `Layout.Section` for the main content flow — tighter spacing control.

Dashboard UX Audit — Full Change List
Context
User requested a full UX audit of the Dashboard page (app/routes/app._index.tsx) with the goal of making it high-converting, easy to adopt for new users, and minimal. No code changes yet — this is the full list of recommended improvements only.

Audit Findings & Recommended Changes
1. STOREFRONT STATUS CARD
Current problems:

Step 1 and Step 2 boxes sit inside the status card with no visual separation from the card header — they blend together
When NOT active, the warning banner AND the two step boxes AND the instruction text below all stack vertically inside the card — too much nesting inside a single card
When active, "Manage App Embeds" and "Edit Widget in Theme" are plain buttons with no context — a new merchant won't know what either does at a glance
The "Refresh" button is plain text next to the badge — low discoverability, no visual cue that it updates the status
Recommended changes:

Active state: Replace the two plain buttons with a single clean line: badge "Active" (green) + theme name + one "Open Theme Editor ↗" link. Remove "Manage App Embeds" button — it's for power users only and clutters the active state
Not active state: Move the two setup steps OUT of the warning banner. Keep the card header (title + badge + refresh). Show a simple numbered list below the Divider — no nested boxes, just two rows with a number, bold label, one-line description, and a link inline. This reduces visual weight significantly
Refresh button: Make it a Button with size="slim" and variant="tertiary" instead of variant="plain" so it has a visible affordance (border/outline)
Card title: Change "Storefront Status" → "App Status" — shorter, cleaner, matches Shopify's own app home card naming
2. UPGRADE BANNER (Free plan only)
Current problems:

Shows BELOW the status card — merchants on free plan who haven't set up the app see: Status Card → Upgrade Banner → Getting Started Card → Stats. Too much content before they can act
The banner text is verbose: "You're on the Free plan — limited to X allowed zip codes only. Pro unlocks unlimited zip codes, blocked zones, delivery rules, and more." Reads like a sales pitch, not helpful guidance
Two actions both go to the same page (/app/pricing) — duplicate, one is enough
Shows even after merchant has zip codes and is happily using the free plan — should only show when they're approaching or at the limit
Recommended changes:

Move upgrade banner to BELOW the stats card (after metrics are shown) — merchant sees their data first, then the upgrade prompt in context
Conditionalize: Only show when usagePercent >= 60 (approaching limit) instead of always showing for all free users
Shorten text: "You've used {stats.total} of {limits.maxZipCodes} zip codes. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited." — one sentence
Single action: Remove secondary "See all plans" — "Upgrade to Pro" is sufficient
3. GETTING STARTED CARD (empty state)
Current problems:

InlineStack with gap="600" and wrap for the 3 steps — on mobile the steps collapse into a vertical stack but each step has no visual separation (no divider, no card background). They all blur together
Step numbering uses a Box with background="bg-surface-secondary" + borderRadius="full" but it's the same grey as the card background — numbers are barely visible
Step 2 button ("Customise Widget") is variant default (outline) while Step 1 is variant="primary" — good hierarchy. But Step 3 ("Set Rules") is also default — Step 1 being primary is correct but shouldn't all non-primary steps look the same? They do, that's fine. No change needed here
The card title "Get started in 3 steps" is fine BUT the card shows even when the app embed is already active AND zip codes are empty — the first action for a merchant who just enabled the embed should be "Add zip codes", not a full 3-step guide
Recommended changes:

Use InlineGrid columns={{ xs: 1, sm: 3 }} instead of InlineStack wrap — gives each step a defined column regardless of screen size, prevents uneven wrapping
Step number circles: Change background="bg-surface-secondary" → background="bg-fill-brand" with tone="text-inverse" for the number text — makes the 1/2/3 circles visually pop (dark background, white number)
Card appears only when isEmpty — already correct. But when isEmpty && appEmbedEnabled, reorder: show Step 1 ("Add Zip Codes") as the only primary focus, visually heavier. Currently fine but step 1 is primary — keep as is
Add a dismissable state: Once a merchant has clicked any step button, the "Get started" card should collapse or show a "Setup complete" note. Currently it never goes away until stats.total > 0. Consider keeping as-is since it disappears naturally once zips are added
4. STATS OVERVIEW CARD
Current problems:

"Overview" title is generic — tells the merchant nothing about what they're looking at
Plan badge ("Free Plan", "Pro Plan") is inside the stats card header — a plan badge belongs in the page header or in a dedicated plan card, not mixed with the metrics. It creates visual noise
The 4 metrics (Zip codes, Allowed zones, Blocked zones, Waitlist entries) use heading2xl for numbers — these are very large. On the Polaris scale heading2xl is ~28px. This is fine for a dashboard but feels heavy alongside bodySm labels
Blocked zones stat shows a "Pro+" badge inline with the metric number on free plan — this is confusing. A merchant sees "0 Pro+" and doesn't immediately understand it means "this feature is locked"
The waitlist "New" badge is tone="new" (purple) on the metric number itself — badge sits inline with the number which is not standard Polaris pattern
"Waitlist entries" metric label is verbose — should be "On Waitlist"
Recommended changes:

Card title: Change "Overview" → "Your Numbers" OR just remove the title entirely — the stats speak for themselves. Most Shopify app dashboards use no title on the stats row
Move plan badge: Remove from stats card header. Put it as a subtitle in the Page component's subtitle prop or as a small badge next to the page title. E.g., subtitle="Free Plan · 3 zip codes"
Blocked zones badge: Replace inline "Pro+" badge with a Tooltip on the stat or a lock icon next to the label — "Blocked zones 🔒" is cleaner than "0 Pro+"
Waitlist badge: Move "New" badge ABOVE the number (as a standalone row) or use a separate small Text line below the metric label ("3 new since last visit") — not inline with the number
Label fix: "Waitlist entries" → "On waitlist"
Delivery Rules metric: Currently in the stats object (stats.deliveryRules) but NOT displayed in the 4-column grid — it's tracked but invisible. Either add it as a 5th metric or remove it from the loader. Currently wasted data
5. PLAN USAGE BAR (free plan only)
Current problems:

Shows INSIDE the stats card at the bottom — it's part of the Overview card but styled differently, creating an inconsistent card section
The progress bar label "Plan usage" is redundant — the bar itself shows the numbers
At <80% usage: no warning shown, just the bar. Fine.
At ≥80%: shows warning text AND an "Upgrade now" button — but the upgrade banner ABOVE already has an "Upgrade to Pro" button. The merchant now has two upgrade CTAs on screen at the same time
Recommended changes:

Move usage bar OUT of the stats card: Put it as its own slim card or as a Banner at the top of the stats section — keeps the stats card clean (numbers only)
Remove duplicate upgrade CTA: When usage ≥ 80%, the existing upgrade banner (once moved below stats) handles the CTA. Remove the "Upgrade now" button from inside the stats card
Simplify label: Just show "{stats.total} / {limits.maxZipCodes} zip codes used" — no "Plan usage" header needed
6. QUICK ACTIONS SECTION
Current problems:

5 cards in a xs:1, sm:2, md:3 grid — on tablet (sm) you get 2 columns with the 5th card spanning alone on the last row. Asymmetric grid looks unfinished
All 5 cards have the same visual weight — no hierarchy. "Manage Zip Codes" is the most important action but looks identical to "Settings & Billing" which is rarely used
Each card has: Icon → H3 → subtext → Button. The button just says "Manage Zip Codes" etc. — same text as the heading. Redundant
"Settings & Billing" card name is confusing — settings and billing are two different concerns. Billing is important (upgrade), settings is secondary
Icons are all the same size/style which is good, but the cards feel dense with 4 elements each
Recommended changes:

Change to xs:1, sm:2, md:2 for bottom section + special treatment for "Manage Zip Codes": Make the ZIP codes card full-width or visually primary (larger, different background) at the top, then 2x2 grid for the remaining 4. This creates clear hierarchy
Remove the button from each card: The entire card is clickable (via onClick on the card). Remove the Button inside and make the card itself the click target. Cleaner, less cluttered. Add a chevron icon (→) at the top-right of each card instead
Split "Settings & Billing": Rename to just "Settings" — billing/upgrade is handled by the upgrade banner. The card can link to /app/settings
Add metric previews to cards: The ZIP codes card already shows the count on the dashboard stats. Repeat a small stat inside the relevant quick action card (e.g., "Manage Zip Codes" card shows "47 active" in subdued text below the heading). This gives merchants a reason to notice/click
Section title: Current section has no title. Add Text variant="headingSm" label "Quick Actions" above the grid, OR remove the label entirely and let the cards stand alone. "Quick Actions" as a label is redundant — remove it
7. PAGE-LEVEL STRUCTURE
Current problems:

The page subtitle is "Zip Code Checker overview" — generic, wastes the subtitle slot
No page-level plan indicator — merchant can't tell at a glance what plan they're on without looking inside a card
primaryAction is "Add Zip Code" with PlusIcon — correct for the primary action, keep as-is
The overall section order is: Status Card → Upgrade Banner → Getting Started → Stats → Quick Actions. This order has two interruptions before the merchant reaches their actual data (stats)
Recommended new section order:

App Status card (always first — Shopify pattern)
Stats card (merchant's data — second most important)
Usage bar (contextual to stats, slim)
Upgrade banner (only when approaching/at limit — after data gives it context)
Getting Started (only when empty)
Quick Actions (always last — navigation shortcuts)
8. EMPTY STATE (no zip codes yet)
Current problems:

When isEmpty === true: the Stats card shows all zeros (0, 0, 0, 0). Showing a stats card full of zeros is demotivating and confusing for a new user
The Getting Started card + an all-zero stats card on the same screen is redundant — the getting started guide is enough
Recommended changes:

Hide the stats card entirely when isEmpty === true — show only: Status card → Getting Started card → Quick Actions
Hide the upgrade banner when isEmpty === true — a brand new user doesn't need a sales pitch before they've added a single zip code
